name: Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer
author: davelabs

sections.description:
Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer helps you manage pages and posts visually by grouping them into custom folders right inside the WordPress admin.

No more long, messy lists of content — with Folderra you can structure your workflow, speed up navigation, and work more efficiently.

Key features:
– Create unlimited folders for pages and posts
– Organize content with simple drag & drop
– Mixed-content folders (pages + posts together)
– Clean and modern admin UI
– Rename, reorder, and duplicate folders
– Fully admin-only — no changes to your front-end

Folderra is designed for creators, site builders, and agencies who manage medium to large websites and want a cleaner way to navigate content.

Why Folderra?

  • 🧩 Keep your WordPress admin structured and easy to browse
  • ⚡ Save time by grouping content logically
  • 🧭 Navigate large sites more efficiently
  • 🖱️ Manage everything visually — no learning curve
  • 🔒 100% safe: no front-end impact, no data overwritten

Folderra works entirely inside the WordPress dashboard.
Additional templates, funnels, and A/B testing tools are available in the separate Folderra PRO – Funnel & Conversion Suite add-on.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, transmit, or share personal data.
All folder data is stored locally in your WordPress installation.
All folder data is stored locally in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Folderra – Smart Folder Organizer.
  3. Go to WP Admin → Smart Folder to start organizing your content.
sections.faq:
Does this change my categories, taxonomies, or permalinks?

No. Smart folders are an admin-only organizational layer.
Your categories, taxonomies, and URLs remain unchanged.

What content types are supported?

Pages and Posts in the free version.
Additional content types may be supported by third-party add-ons or via Folderra PRO.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No. Folderra runs only in the admin area and does not add front-end scripts or styles.

Is my content safe?

Yes. The plugin never modifies or deletes your original posts or pages.
It only manages folder relationships stored safely in your database.
